clips.title: The story
paras: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun in Ratchet wants the guns at Northwatch Hold silenced. Alliance gunners there have been blasting merchant vessels, so he sends you down the Merchant Coast to strike the artillery officers and bring back badges from fallen infantry.

Northwatch Hold guards the southern Barrens coast for the humans of Theramore. Its soldiers watch Horde activity in Kalimdor, but fear has made them see every unfamiliar sail as a threat. The guns on the ramparts fire without warning at passing ships, endangering Ratchet's merchant traffic and its privateering vessels.

Captain Brightsun wants the attacks on his ships answered. Captain Fairmount commands Northwatch, with Whessan and Smythe directing its guns. Defeating them and taking Theramore medals from the garrison throws the artillery into disarray and gives Ratchet's ships room to travel along the Merchant Coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!
Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!

clips.title: Progress
paras: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, friend.
Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
